x: Handicap Team.—Belgrave “ B ” (Bentley, Bidgood, Sapcote, True), 204.40.
A keen spectator and assistant at this meeting was Bidgood, junior. He informs us that he plays rugger? ? ? ?

At seven miles Proctor was well away in the lead, Charlie and Mac still 5th and 6th, Readman 12th, Oliver 18th, Sapcote 20th, Bidgood 24th, Bentley 26th, Wright 28th, with Clayton taking it easy owing to a strained leg.

…rcher and Pat Sapcote, with Bob McMullen, walking his first 20, some 40 yards further back, followed by Messrs. Wright, Bidgood, Bentley and Oliver. It is interesting to note that Jack Rutland, who finished 4th, was at this stage 12th.…
(Mention should here be made of an incident before the race when Syd Roberts met with a street accident just before meeting Jack Bidgood and Co. at Chelsea.

The individual titles have also been won by our walkers, viz., Readman, Readman and Bidgood respectively. Mick Porter finished 5th in the Doncaster to Sheffield Marathon Race on Easter Monday, which was run in very bad weather conditions.

At half distance we had a four point lead, with the “ A ” team scoring: Jack Rutland 2, Jack Bidgood 4, Jack Wakeley 9, Bert Clayton was close behind but was having an off day owing to a badly bruised heel.

Those to have finished the distance inside 9 hours and excluding the performances just quoted are Bellchamber (twice), Miles, Rathbone, Bentley, Martin (R.) (4 times), Bidgood (3 times), Rickards (twice), Urry (twice), Sutton (twice), Baker and Stirling Wakeley.
Handicap Team Race: 1, Belgrave H. “C,” 203 mins. (Tebbutt, McGreechan, Jarlett, Warr); 3, Belgrave H. “A,” 207.54 (McMullen, James, Readman, Bidgood).

Eight miles was reached by Clayton in 70.36, closely followed by McGreechan, Wright and Checkley; 350 yards behind came Bidgood, Bellchambers, Shields and Rutland, and a further 200 yards Wakeley and Readman, closely followed by Sapcote, Sutton and Robins.

We have had a number of placed men - Tommy Green on three occasions - but never a winner. Here's a target for next year; to beat our 1938 winning team score of 23 points (Bentley 2, Sutton 4, Bidgood 8 Rickards 9)!
